title: Dub
tagline: A stripped-back take on rhythm that makes space itself part of the song.
summary: Dub takes the rhythm section and the studio as the main instruments, turning mix and echo into an artistic force. It often strips songs down to a bassline and drums, then reshapes the sound with delay, subtraction and reverb. The result is a music of atmosphere, depth and intentional space.

pillars.name: Lee “Scratch” Perry
pillars.why: Lee “Scratch” Perry transformed dub into a sonic practice that treated the studio as an instrument in its own right.

pillars.name: King Tubby
pillars.why: King Tubby used mixing and echo to create a monumental sense of movement and depth in the form.

pillars.name: Augustus Pablo
pillars.why: Augustus Pablo linked dub to melodic improvisation and a sensitive, atmospheric touch.
